parameters.query: WITH payload AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc), eligible AS (SELECT pr.id AS request_id FROM project_requests pr JOIN project_blueprints pb ON pb.request_id=pr.id CROSS JOIN payload p WHERE pr.id=(p.doc->>'requestDbId')::uuid AND pr.source='operations-hub' AND pr.company_name LIKE 'Synthetic %' AND pb.approval_status='pending' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p.doc->'data'->'relevantSourceIds') AS cited(source_id) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(pb.solution_blueprint->'data'->'evidence','[]'::jsonb)) AS evidence(item) WHERE evidence.item->>'sourceId'=cited.source_id))), inserted AS (INSERT INTO agent_runs (id,request_id,started_at,finished_at,agent_name,status,model_name,prompt_version,input_data,output_data,duration_ms,input_tokens,output_tokens,estimated_cost_usd,approval_status,outcome) SELECT (p.doc->>'runId')::uuid,e.request_id,NOW()-((p.doc->>'durationMs')::int*INTERVAL '1 millisecond'),NOW(),'AI Interpretation Agent','completed',p.doc->>'model',p.doc->>'promptVersion',jsonb_build_object('local',true,'synthetic',true),p.doc->'data',(p.doc->>'durationMs')::int,(p.doc->'usage'->>'inputTokens')::int,(p.doc->'usage'->>'outputTokens')::int,0,'pending','advisory-only' FROM eligible e CROSS JOIN payload p ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id,request_id), audited AS (INSERT INTO audit_events (request_id,event_type,actor,details) SELECT i.request_id,'local-ai-interpretation.completed','AI Interpretation Agent',jsonb_build_object('stage','aiInterpretation','status','completed','modelName',p.doc->>'model','promptVersion',p.doc->>'promptVersion','durationMs',(p.doc->>'durationMs')::int,'inputTokens',(p.doc->'usage'->>'inputTokens')::int,'outputTokens',(p.doc->'usage'->>'outputTokens')::int,'estimatedCostUsd',0,'executionGate',false) FROM inserted i CROSS JOIN payload p RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT id::text FROM inserted) AS "runId",(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audited)::int AS "auditEventsWritten";
